title: YouTube Channel Email & Contact Scraper
description: Discover YouTube channels by URL or niche and return public contact records (emails, phones, websites, socials). Prefer the default public scrape. Use only permitted direct/public or licensed API access verified against the actual build. Stop on access denial or rate limits; see the source access gate.

channelUrls.title: YouTube channel URLs
channelUrls.description: Use this field when the user provides specific YouTube channel names, handles, or URLs (e.g. '@mkbhd', 'youtube.com/@MrBeast', a list of creators). Accepts @handle URLs, /channel/ID URLs, or video URLs. Each URL = 1 channel scraped. Use channelUrls when the user says 'get emails for these channels', 'scrape this list of YouTubers', or 'find contact info for [specific creator]'. You can combine with searchQueries.

searchQueries.title: Search by niche or keyword (auto-discover channels)
searchQueries.description: Use this field when the user describes a niche, topic, or industry instead of specific channels (e.g. 'fitness influencers', 'tech reviewers', 'cooking YouTube channels'). The actor searches YouTube and auto-discovers matching channels. Use searchQueries when the user says 'find YouTube channels about X', 'build me a list of influencers in [niche]', 'discover creators who cover [topic]', or 'get emails for [industry] YouTubers'. Each query returns up to 20 channels. Stack multiple queries for large lists.

maxResults.title: Maximum channels to scrape
maxResults.description: How many YouTube channels to extract contact data from in total (across all URLs and search queries combined). Set to 10–20 for a quick test. Set to 500–5000 for bulk influencer outreach lists. A channel with a public email charges the $0.05 Channel Result event. Default: 100 channels. Use only permitted direct/public or licensed API access verified against the actual build. Stop on access denial or rate limits; see the source access gate.

scrapeWebsite.title: Read public website contacts
scrapeWebsite.description: When enabled, the actor visits the website linked on each channel's About page and scrapes it for additional email addresses and contact info. This is the most powerful feature — many creators list their business email only on their website, not on YouTube. Increases email hit rate by 30–50%. Slightly increases run time. Highly recommended: keep this ON.

followLinkAggregators.title: Follow Linktree, Beacons, Bio.link pages
followLinkAggregators.description: When enabled, the actor follows link aggregator pages (Linktree, Beacons.ai, Bio.link, Campsite, Bento, etc.) found in channel About sections. These pages often contain business emails, booking links, and all social profiles in one place. Recommended: keep this ON for maximum contact data coverage.
